cases.name: Chelsea Ann Wallen
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Chelsea attended Colon High School. She resided in Colon her entire life. Chelsea worked as a manager at Countryside Quality Meats in Union City.

Chelsea’s greatest joy in life was her children. They meant the world to her. She loved spending time with them especially on the river. Kayaking down the river was her favorite pastime. She put everything she could into her job and took pride in it.

Her smile is what she would want her family and friends to remember. No matter the circumstances she always had a smile for anyone and everyone."
